info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Botallac Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of detailed information for the Botallac Recliner product. It allows users to create and update detailed descriptions, features, pricing, and specifications related to the Botallac Recliner. Typically utilized by product managers and catalog administrators, this API streamlines the process of populating product catalogs with precise and structured data. Efficient use of this API ensures that customers have access to accurate and comprehensive information, enhancing their buying experience.

post.summary: Create details for a Botallac recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information for a specific Botallac recliner model. Providing comprehensive information is essential for ensuring accurate product representation and customer satisfaction.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details needed to create or update a Botallac recliner product. The data should conform to the specified JSON schema for proper processing.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, returning the requested data.
